sdpa_signature_doc: Computes scaled dot product attention on query, key and value tensors, using an optional attention mask if passed,
event_elapsed_time_doc:
Return the time elapsed.

        Time reported in milliseconds after the event was recorded and
        before the end_event was recorded.

        Args:
            end_event (Event): the end event.
scale_and_gqa_local_support: Verified in installed API and actual Gate 0; enable_gqa Hq/Hkv=2; scale explicit; dropout=0; square causal/noncausal; no arbitrary mask adapter.
